In the 2024 Farm Bill and subsequent regulatory updates, these systems have even gained traction for carbon fencing, allowing farmers to generate data they can sell while saving money. This data is often hosted in the cloud, sometimes in the U.S. rather than on local servers, which was a major concern for privacy advocates. Yet, these are commercial drivers.
